experiment: Grounded-corpus retrain vs dissertation adapters, 24 held-out-app stories (saucedemo+the-internet, UNSEEN in grounded training)
headline: Training on the execution-verified grounded corpus ELIMINATED the data-testid convention bias entirely (47/48 -> 0/48) on apps never seen during grounded training. Execution improved on Cypress (0/24 -> 2/24 full +5 partial; 0/40 -> 9/38 individual tests) but only modestly, and Playwright stayed flat -- confirming that training-time grounding removes the learned bias yet full execution on UNSEEN apps still needs inference-time grounding (injecting the target app DOM), since the model cannot know a novel apps exact selectors from training alone.
